protocol.source: uniform independent river card states; synthetic, not personal play
protocol.selection: Validation MAE chooses checkpoint and serving research candidate. Test is evaluated only after all configurations finish; no tuning on test. Three new seeds, unchanged quality thresholds. No automatic promotion.
ablations: omit evaluator-derived features; same residual network and optimizer
protocol.previous_evaluation: New independent generation seed; audit exact canonical visible-card overlap against previous frozen equity shards and exclude collisions before split. Prior test results are never loaded by fitting.
